units.en: In Xuantong 1, Shen Jiaben and others gathered the various opinions and again submitted a revised draft.
units.literal: In Xuantong 1, Shen Jiaben and others collected the various opinions and again memorialized submitting a revised draft.

units.zh: 時江蘇提學使勞乃宣上書憲政編查館論之曰：「法律大臣會同法部奏進修改刑律，義關倫常諸條，未依舊律修入。
units.en: At the time Jiangsu provincial education commissioner Lao Naixuan wrote to the Constitutional Research Bureau, arguing: "The legal ministers, together with the Ministry of Justice, submitted the revised penal code, yet the articles concerning human relations and moral norms were not incorporated from the old code.
units.literal: At the time Jiangsu provincial education commissioner Lao Naixuan wrote to the Constitutional Research Bureau arguing: "The legal ministers, jointly with the Ministry of Justice, memorialized submitting the revised penal code, yet the articles concerning human relations and constant norms were not revised into it according to the old code.

units.zh: 但於附則稱中國宗教遵孔，以綱常禮教為重。
units.en: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction weigh most heavily.
units.literal: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction are paramount.

units.zh: 如律中十惡親屬容隱，干名犯義，存留養親，及親屬相奸、相盜、相毆，發冢犯奸各條，未便蔑棄。
units.en: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery ought not to be cast aside lightly.
units.literal: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery—these should not lightly be cast aside.

units.zh: 中國人有犯以上各罪，應仍依舊律，別輯單行法，以昭懲創。
units.en: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code in a separately compiled special law, to make punishment and deterrence clear.
units.literal: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code, compiled separately as a special law, to manifest punishment and deterrence.

units.zh: 竊維修訂新律，本為籌備立憲，統一法權。
units.en: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally intended to prepare for constitutional government and unify legal authority.
units.literal: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally meant to prepare for constitutionalism and unify legal authority.

units.zh: 凡中國人及在中國居住之外國人，皆應服從同一法律。
units.en: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should be subject to the same law.
units.literal: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should obey the same law.

units.zh: 是此法律，本當以治中國人為主。
units.en: This law should chiefly govern the Chinese.
units.literal: This law should primarily govern Chinese.

units.zh: 今乃依舊律別輯中國人單行法，是視此新刑律專為外國人設矣。
units.en: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as if it were made exclusively for foreigners.
units.literal: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as designed exclusively for foreigners.

units.zh: 本末倒置，莫此為甚。
units.en: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more perverse.
units.literal: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more extreme than this.

units.zh: 草案案語謂修訂刑律，所以收回領事裁判權。
units.en: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is meant to reclaim consular jurisdiction.
units.literal: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is for reclaiming consular jurisdiction.

units.zh: 刑律內有一二條為外國人所不遵奉，即無收回裁判權之實。
units.en: If foreigners refuse to observe even one or two articles in the penal code, there is in reality no reclaiming of judicial authority.
units.literal: If one or two articles in the penal code are not observed by foreigners, there is in fact no reclaiming of judicial authority.

units.zh: 故所修刑律，專以摹仿外國為事。
units.en: Therefore the revised penal code has devoted itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.
units.literal: Therefore the revised penal code devotes itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.

units.zh: 此說實不盡然。
units.en: This claim is not entirely accurate.
units.literal: This claim is not entirely true.

units.zh: 泰西各國，凡外國人居其國中，無不服從其國法律，不得執本國無此律以相爭，亦不得恃本國有此律以相抗。
units.en: In all Western countries, foreigners residing within their borders must obey the laws of those countries; they may neither argue that their own country has no such law nor rely on their own country's law to resist.
units.literal: In all Western countries, whatever foreigners reside in their lands must obey the laws of those lands; they may not argue that their own country has no such law, nor rely on their own country having such a law to resist.

units.zh: 今中國修訂刑律，乃謂為收回領事裁判權，必盡舍固有之禮教風俗，一一摹仿外國。
units.en: Now, in revising China's penal code, it is said that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must wholly abandon China's own ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.
units.literal: Now in revising China's penal code, one says that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must entirely abandon inherent ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.

units.zh: 則同乎此國者，彼國有違言，同乎彼國者，此國又相反，是必窮之道也。
units.en: Then whatever matches this country, that country will reject; whatever matches that country, this country will reject—a path that can only end in deadlock.
units.literal: Then what accords with this country, that country will object to; what accords with that country, this country will oppose—the way of certain exhaustion.

units.zh: 總之一國之律，必與各國之律相同，然後乃能令國內居住之外國人遵奉，萬萬無此理，亦萬萬無此事。
units.en: In short, the notion that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey them is utterly without principle and utterly impossible.
units.literal: In sum, that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey—there is absolutely no such principle, and absolutely no such possibility.

units.zh: 以此為收回領事裁判權之策，是終古無收回之望也。
units.en: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to abandon all hope of ever reclaiming it.
units.literal: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to have no hope of reclaiming it through all time.

units.zh: 且夫國之有刑，所以弼教。
units.en: Moreover, a state maintains punishments in order to assist moral instruction.
units.literal: Moreover, a state has punishments in order to assist instruction.

units.zh: 一國之民有不遵禮教者，以刑齊之。
units.en: When the people of a state fail to observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into line.
units.literal: When the people of a state do not observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into alignment.

units.zh: 所謂禮防未然，刑禁已然，相輔而行，不可缺一者也。
units.en: This is what is meant by saying that ritual guards against what has not yet happened and punishments restrain what has already happened: the two assist each other, and neither can be dispensed with.
units.literal: What is called ritual guarding against what has not yet happened and punishments restraining what has already happened—they proceed in mutual assistance and neither may be lacking.

units.zh: 故各省簽駁草案，每以維持風化立論，而案語乃指為渾道德法律為一。
units.en: Therefore, when the various provinces annotated objections to the draft, they often argued from the need to uphold public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law.
units.literal: Therefore the various provinces, in annotating objections to the draft, often argued from maintaining public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law into one.

units.zh: 其論無夫奸曰：『國家立法，期於令行禁止。
units.en: Its discussion of adultery without a husband says: "When the state makes laws, it expects them to be enforced and obeyed.
units.literal: Its discussion of adultery without a husband says: "When the state legislates, it expects orders to be enforced and prohibitions obeyed.

units.zh: 有法而不能行，轉使民玩法而肆無忌憚。
units.en: When laws exist but cannot be enforced, the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.
units.literal: When there is law but it cannot be enforced, it only makes the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.

units.zh: 和姦之事，幾于禁之無可禁，誅之不勝誅，即刑章具在，亦祗具文。
units.en: In cases of consensual adultery, prohibition is nearly impossible and punishment cannot keep pace; even when the penal code is complete, it remains only words on paper.
units.literal: In cases of consensual adultery, prohibition is nearly impossible and punishment cannot keep pace; even with the penal code complete, it is only text on paper.

units.zh: 必教育普及，家庭嚴正，輿論之力盛，廉恥之心生，然後淫靡之風可少衰。』
units.en: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame takes root can the tide of debauchery begin to recede.
units.literal: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, the force of public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame arises can the tide of debauchery somewhat abate.

units.zh: 又曰：『防遏此等醜行，不在法律而在教化。
units.en: It also says: "To check such vile conduct lies not in law but in moral instruction."
units.literal: It also says: "To check such vile conduct lies not in law but in moral instruction."

units.zh: 即列為專條，亦無實際。』
units.en: Even if such conduct were made the subject of separate articles, there would be no practical effect."
units.literal: Even if set forth as separate articles, there is no practical effect."

units.zh: 其立論在離法律與道德教化而二之，視法律為全無關於道德教化，故一意摹仿外國，而於舊律義關倫常諸條棄之如遺，焉用此法為乎？」
units.en: Its argument separates law from moral instruction, treating law as wholly unrelated to moral instruction; therefore it single-mindedly imitates foreign countries and casts aside the old code's articles on human relations and moral norms like rubbish—of what use is such a law?"
units.literal: Its argument separates law from moral instruction into two, treating law as wholly unrelated to moral instruction; therefore it single-mindedly imitates foreign countries and casts aside like rubbish the old code's articles on human relations and constant norms—of what use is such a law?"

units.zh: 謂宜將舊律有關禮教倫紀各節，逐一修入正文，並擬補干名犯義、犯罪存留養親、親屬相奸相毆、無夫奸、子孫違犯教令各條。
units.en: He urged that each section of the old code concerning ritual instruction and ethical order be incorporated one by one into the main text, and proposed adding articles on offenses against names and violation of righteousness, offenders remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery and assault among relatives, adultery without a husband, and descendants violating parental commands.
units.literal: He urged that each section of the old code concerning ritual instruction and ethical order be revised one by one into the main text, and proposed supplementing articles on offenses against names and violation of righteousness, offenders remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery and assault among relatives, adultery without a husband, and descendants violating parental commands.

units.zh: 法律館爭之。
units.en: The Law Compilation Office contested this.
units.literal: The Law Compilation Office disputed this.

units.zh: 明年資政院開，憲政編查館奏交院議，將總則通過。
units.en: The next year the Advisory Council convened; the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted the draft to the council for deliberation, and the General Provisions were passed.
units.literal: The next year the Advisory Council opened; the Constitutional Research Bureau memorialized submitting it to the council for deliberation, and the General Provisions were passed.

units.zh: 時勞乃宣充議員，與同院內閣學士陳寶琛等，於無夫奸及違犯教令二條尤力持不少怠，而分則遂未議決。
units.en: At the time Lao Naixuan served as a councilor; together with fellow councilor Grand Secretary Chen Baochen and others, he especially held firm without yielding on the two articles concerning adultery without a husband and violation of parental commands, but the Specific Provisions were never decided.
units.literal: At the time Lao Naixuan served as a councilor; together with fellow councilor Grand Secretary Chen Baochen and others, he especially held firm without slackening on the two articles concerning adultery without a husband and violation of parental commands, but the Specific Provisions were ultimately not decided.

units.zh: 餘如民律、商律、刑事訴訟律、民事訴訟律、國籍法俱編纂告竣，未經核議。
units.en: Other codes, such as the Civil Code, Commercial Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Civil Procedure Code, and Nationality Law, were all compiled and completed but had not yet been reviewed.
units.literal: The rest, such as the Civil Code, Commercial Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Civil Procedure Code, and Nationality Law, were all compiled and finished but had not yet been reviewed.

units.zh: 惟法院編制法、違警律、禁煙條例均經宣統二年頒布，與現行刑律僅行之一年，而遜位之詔下矣。
units.en: Only the Court Organization Law, Public Order Offenses Law, and Opium Prohibition Regulations were promulgated in Xuantong 2; the Current Penal Code had been in force for barely a year when the abdication edict was issued.
units.literal: Only the Court Organization Law, Public Order Offenses Law, and Opium Prohibition Regulations were all promulgated in Xuantong 2; and the Current Penal Code had been in force for only one year when the abdication edict was issued.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 於是招進張湯、趙禹之屬，條定法令，作見知故縱、監臨部主之法，緩深故之罪，急縱出之誅。
units.en: Legal technocrats expanded doctrinal categories and tightened accountability frameworks, especially around supervisory responsibility.
units.literal: Then Zhang Tang, Zhao Yu and their type were recruited, sorting and fixing laws and ordinances, making statutes on 'seeing and knowing, intentional release,' and 'supervisory department heads,' relaxing deep-old crimes yet sharpening punishment for deliberate release.

units.zh: 三十一年，修訂法律大臣沈家本等奏請刪除重法數端，略稱：「見行律例款目極繁，而最重之法，亟應先議刪除者，約有三事：一曰凌遲、梟首、戮屍。
units.en: In 1905 revising law ministers Shen Jiaben and others memorialized to abolish several severe punishments, noting: "Current statutes are vast, but three exceptionally harsh penalties should be removed first: lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year the revising law ministers Shen Jiaben and others memorialized requesting deletion of several heavy punishments, stating in summary: "The articles of the current code and sub-statutes are extremely numerous, and among the heaviest punishments those that urgently should be discussed for deletion number roughly three: first, lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment.

units.zh: 凌遲之刑，唐以前無此名目。
units.en: Lingchi did not exist as a named punishment before the Tang.
units.literal: The punishment of lingchi had no such name before the Tang dynasty.

units.zh: 遼史刑法志始列入正刑之內。
units.en: The penal monograph of the History of Liao first listed it among formal statutory punishments.
units.literal: The penal monograph of the History of Liao first listed it among the orthodox punishments.

units.zh: 宋自熙寧以後，漸亦沿用。
units.en: From the Song Xining era onward it gradually came into use.
units.literal: From the Xining era of the Song onward it was gradually adopted as well.

units.zh: 元、明至今，相仍未改。
units.en: From Yuan and Ming times to the present it remained unchanged.
units.literal: From Yuan and Ming down to the present it has continued unchanged.

units.zh: 梟首在秦、漢時惟用諸夷族之誅，六朝梁、陳、齊、周諸律，始於斬之外別立梟名。
units.en: In Qin and Han, display of the severed head applied only to clan extermination; Six Dynasties codes of Liang, Chen, Qi, and Zhou first made it a separate penalty beyond decapitation.
units.literal: Display of the severed head in Qin and Han was used only for extermination of the clan; in the Six Dynasties the codes of Liang, Chen, Qi, and Zhou first established the separate category of head display beyond decapitation.

units.zh: 自隋迄元，復棄而不用。
units.en: From Sui through Yuan it fell out of use again.
units.literal: From Sui through Yuan it was again abandoned and not used.

units.zh: 今之斬梟，仍明制也。
units.en: Today's decapitation with head displayed still follows Ming practice.
units.literal: Today's decapitation with head displayed still follows the Ming system.

units.zh: 戮屍一事，惟秦時成蟜軍反，其軍吏皆斬戮屍，見於始皇本紀。
units.en: Corpse dismemberment appears only once in early records: when Prince Cheng Jiao's army rebelled in Qin, his officers were decapitated and their corpses dismembered, as recorded in the First Emperor's annals.
units.literal: As for corpse dismemberment, only when Prince Cheng Jiao's army rebelled in Qin were his military officers all decapitated and their corpses dismembered, as recorded in the Basic Annals of the First Emperor.

units.zh: 此外歷代刑制，俱無此法。
units.en: No other dynasty's penal system included this punishment.
units.literal: Apart from this, penal systems of successive dynasties all lacked this punishment.

units.zh: 明自萬曆十六年，定有戮屍條例，專指謀殺祖父母、父母而言。
units.en: In 1588 the Ming fixed a corpse-dismemberment statute specifically for plotting to kill grandparents or parents.
units.literal: From the sixteenth year of Wanli in the Ming a sub-statute on corpse dismemberment was fixed, referring specifically to plotting to kill grandparents or parents.

units.zh: 國朝因之，後更推及於強盜。
units.en: The Qing followed suit and later extended it to armed robbery.
units.literal: Our dynasty followed this, and later extended it further to armed robbery.

units.zh: 凡此酷重之刑，固所以懲戒兇惡。
units.en: These cruelly severe punishments were meant to chastise the vicious.
units.literal: All these cruelly heavy punishments were indeed intended to chastise the vicious and wicked.

units.zh: 第刑至於斬，身首分離，已為至慘。
units.en: Yet decapitation already severed body from head—the utmost cruelty.
units.literal: But when punishment reached decapitation, with body and head separated, it was already the utmost cruelty.

units.zh: 若命在頃忽，菹醢必令備嘗，氣久消亡，刀鋸猶難倖免，揆諸仁人之心，當必慘然不樂。
units.en: When life lasts but a moment yet the condemned must endure every form of mincing and dissection, and long after death knife and saw still mutilate the corpse, any humane heart must recoil in horror.
units.literal: If life lasts but a moment, yet mincing and dismemberment must all be tasted in full; long after breath has vanished, knife and saw still cannot be escaped—measured against the heart of a humane person, this must surely inspire grief and displeasure.

units.zh: 謂將以懲本犯，而被刑者魂魄何知；
units.en: If the aim is to punish the offender, what could the dead know?
units.literal: If one says it is to punish the principal offender, what could the executed person's soul know?

units.zh: 謂將以警戒眾人，而習見習聞，轉感召其殘忍之性，實非聖世所宜遵。
units.en: If the aim is to warn the public, habitual exposure to such cruelty only nurtures brutality—hardly fitting for an enlightened age.
units.literal: If one says it is to warn the multitude, yet through constant sight and hearing it instead summons forth their cruel nature—this is truly not what a sage age should follow.

units.zh: 請將凌遲、梟首、戮屍三項，一概刪除，死罪至斬決而止。
units.en: We request abolition of lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment, limiting capital punishment to immediate decapitation.
units.literal: We request that the three items of lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment be wholly deleted, and that capital punishment stop at immediate decapitation.

units.zh: 凡律例內凌遲、斬梟各條，俱改斬決。
units.en: All code and sub-statute articles prescribing lingchi or decapitation with head displayed should be changed to immediate decapitation.
units.literal: All articles in the code and sub-statutes on lingchi and decapitation with head displayed should be changed to immediate decapitation.

units.zh: 斬決而下，依次遞減。
units.en: Lesser penalties below immediate decapitation should be reduced accordingly.
units.literal: Below immediate decapitation, punishments should be reduced step by step in order.

units.zh: 一曰緣坐。
units.en: Second: guilt by association.
units.literal: Second: guilt by association.

units.zh: 緣坐之制，起於秦之參夷及收司連坐法。
units.en: Guilt by association originated in Qin practices of clan extermination and joint punishment of related officials.
units.literal: The institution of guilt by association originated in Qin practices of collective extermination and joint punishment of related officials.

units.zh: 漢高後除三族令，文帝除收孥相坐律，當時以為盛德。
units.en: Empress Lü abolished clan extermination; Emperor Wen ended the seizure of wives and children for joint punishment—both hailed as great acts of mercy.
units.literal: Empress Lü of Han abolished the decree on extermination of three clans; Emperor Wen abolished the law on seizing wives and children for joint punishment—at the time these were regarded as great acts of virtue.

units.zh: 惜夷族之誅，猶間用之。
units.en: Clan extermination regrettably persisted in occasional use.
units.literal: Regrettably, extermination of the clan was still occasionally applied.

units.zh: 晉以下仍有家屬從坐之法，唐律惟反叛、惡逆、不道，律有緣坐，他無有也。
units.en: From Jin onward families could still share punishment, but Tang law limited guilt by association to rebellion, felonious contumacy against parents or grandparents (e'ni), and crimes of inhumanity (budao) alone.
units.literal: From Jin onward there remained laws for family members to share punishment; in the Tang Code only rebellion, felonious contumacy (e'ni), and inhumanity (budao) had guilt by association in the code—nothing else did.

units.zh: 今律則奸黨、交結近侍諸項俱緣坐矣，反獄、邪教諸項亦緣坐矣。
units.en: Today's code extends guilt by association to factionalism, collusion with palace attendants, prison revolt, heterodox sects, and more.
units.literal: In today's code, factionalism, collusion with palace attendants, and similar items all involve guilt by association; prison revolt, heterodox sects, and similar items also involve guilt by association.

units.zh: 一案株連，動輒數十人。
units.en: A single case could implicate dozens of people.
units.literal: In a single case implicated persons often numbered dozens.

units.zh: 夫以一人之故而波及全家，以無罪之人而科以重罪，漢文帝以為不正之法反害於民，北魏崔挺嘗曰『一人有罪，延及闔門，則司馬牛受桓魋之罰，柳下惠膺盜跖之誅，不亦哀哉』，其言皆篤論也。
units.en: Punishing an entire family for one person's crime and imposing heavy penalties on the innocent—Emperor Wen of Han called such law harmful to the people; Cui Ting of Northern Wei wrote that when one person's guilt reaches the whole household, "Sima Niu would suffer Huan Tui's punishment and Liu Xiahui would bear Zhi's execution—is this not lamentable?"—sound judgment all.
units.literal: To involve an entire family because of one person's offense, and to impose heavy punishment on the innocent—Emperor Wen of Han regarded such improper law as harmful to the people; Cui Ting of Northern Wei once said, "When one person is guilty and the whole household is implicated, then Sima Niu would suffer Huan Tui's punishment and Liu Xiahui would bear Zhi's execution—is this not lamentable?"—all such words are sound judgment.

units.zh: 今世各國，皆主持刑罰止及一身之義，與『罪人不孥』之古訓實相符合。
units.en: Modern nations uphold punishment limited to the offender alone, in keeping with the ancient teaching that guilt does not extend to one's family.
units.literal: All nations today uphold the principle that punishment extends only to the person himself, which truly accords with the ancient teaching that "punishment does not reach the offender's children."

units.zh: 請將律內緣坐各條，除知情者仍坐罪外，其不知情者悉予寬免。
units.en: We request that guilt-by-association articles punish only those who knew of the offense; all who did not know should be exempted.
units.literal: We request that in all articles on guilt by association in the code, except those who knew of the offense and are still punished, all who did not know be wholly remitted.

units.zh: 餘條有科及家屬者准此。
units.en: Other articles imposing penalties on family members should follow the same rule.
units.literal: Other articles that impose punishment on family members should follow this rule.

units.zh: 一曰刺字。
units.en: Third: tattooing.
units.literal: Third: tattooing.

units.zh: 刺字乃古墨刑，漢之黥也。
units.en: Tattooing was the ancient ink punishment—the Han-era branding penalty.
units.literal: Tattooing was the ancient ink punishment—the branding of Han.

units.zh: 文帝廢肉刑而黥亦廢，魏、晉、六朝雖有逃奴劫盜之刺，旋行旋廢。
units.en: Emperor Wen abolished corporal punishment and branding with it; Wei, Jin, and Six Dynasties occasionally tattooed runaway slaves and robbers, but the practice came and went.
units.literal: Emperor Wen abolished corporal punishment and branding was abolished as well; though Wei, Jin, and the Six Dynasties occasionally tattooed runaway slaves and robbers, the practice was adopted and abandoned in turn.

units.zh: 隋、唐皆無此法。
units.en: Neither Sui nor Tang law included tattooing.
units.literal: Sui and Tang both lacked this punishment.

units.zh: 至石晉天福間，始創刺配之制，相沿至今。
units.en: Later Jin's Tianfu era first combined tattooing with exile—a practice that continued to the present.
units.literal: Only in the Tianfu era of Later Jin was the system of tattooing combined with exile first created, and it has continued down to the present.

units.zh: 其初不過竊盜逃人，其後日加煩密。
units.en: Initially it applied only to thieves and fugitives; later it grew ever more elaborate.
units.literal: At first it applied only to thieves and fugitives; later it grew daily more elaborate and detailed.

units.zh: 在立法之意，原欲使莠民知恥，庶幾悔過而遷善。
units.en: The original intent was to shame habitual offenders into repentance and reform.
units.literal: In the legislative intent, the original aim was to make wicked commoners know shame, so that they might repent and turn to goodness.

units.zh: 詎知習於為非者，適予以標識，助其兇橫。
units.en: Yet for habitual criminals the mark became a badge of defiance, fueling their brutality.
units.literal: Who could have known that those habituated to wrongdoing would instead be given a mark that aided their ferocity and arrogance?

units.zh: 而偶罹法網者，則黥刺一膺，終身僇辱。
units.en: Those who fell into the law's net by misfortune bore a chest tattoo and lifelong disgrace.
units.literal: Yet those who chanced to fall into the net of the law, once branded on the chest, suffered lifelong shame and humiliation.

units.zh: 夫肉刑久廢，而此法獨存，漢文所謂刻肌膚痛而不德者，未能收弼教之益，而徒留此不德之名，豈仁政所宜出此。
units.en: Corporal punishment was long abolished, yet tattooing alone survived—what Emperor Wen called "cutting flesh and causing pain without virtue." It aided neither reform nor instruction but left only a stain on humane governance.
units.literal: Corporal punishment was long abolished, yet this law alone remained—what Han Emperor Wen called cutting the flesh and causing pain without virtue; it failed to achieve the benefit of assisting instruction, and only left this name for lack of virtue—how could humane governance produce such a thing?

units.zh: 擬請將刺字款目，概行刪除。
units.en: We propose abolishing all tattooing provisions.
units.literal: It is proposed to delete all articles on tattooing entirely.

units.zh: 凡竊盜皆令收所習藝，按罪名輕重，定以年限，俾一技能嫻，得以餬口，自少再犯、三犯之人。
units.en: All thieves should enter vocational training for terms scaled to offense severity, mastering a trade to earn a living and reducing repeat offenders.
units.literal: All thieves should be received into vocational training institutions; according to the severity of the offense a term of years should be fixed, so that once a skill is mastered they may earn a living, thereby reducing repeat and third-time offenders.

units.zh: 一切遞解人犯，嚴令地方官僉差押解，果能實力奉行，逃亡者自少也。」
units.en: Local officials should strictly escort all forwarded convicts; if enforced, escapes would naturally decline."
units.literal: For all convicts forwarded under escort, local officials should be strictly ordered to assign personnel for guarded transport; if this were truly enforced, fugitives would naturally be fewer."

units.zh: 奏上，諭令凌遲、梟首、戮屍三項永遠刪除。
units.en: The memorial was approved, and an edict permanently abolished lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict ordered that the three items of lingchi, display of the severed head, and corpse dismemberment be permanently deleted.

units.zh: 宣統嗣立，與攝政醇親王同受遺詔，加太子少保，晉太子太保。
units.en: When Xuantong succeeded to the throne, he and the regent Prince Chun together received the testamentary edict. He was given the rank Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and then advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: When Xuantong succeeded, together with Regent Prince Chun he received the testamentary edict, was given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 嘉慶初元，再舉千叟宴，朝鮮、安南、暹羅、廓爾喀額爾德尼王吉爾巴納足塔畢噶爾瑪薩九叩，「跪奉大皇帝前：竊小臣聞湖南教匪滋事，致天威震怒，遣兵剿除。
units.en: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.

units.zh: 二十一年，英復遣使來貢，執事者告以須行拜跪禮，司當冬等遂稱疾不入覲，帝怒，諭遣歸國，罷筵宴賜物。
units.en: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.

units.zh: 時酷吏周興、來俊臣、丘神勣、王弘義等構陷無辜，皆抵極法，公卿震恐，莫敢正言。
units.en: Cruel officials such as Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, Qiu Shenji, and Wang Hongyi framed the innocent to extreme punishments while the court fell silent.
units.literal: At the time the cruel officials Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, Qiu Shenji, Wang Hongyi, and others framed the innocent; all reached extreme law; dukes and ministers trembled in fear and none dared speak straight.

units.zh: 俊臣、張知默等又抗表請申大法，則天不許之。
units.en: Lai Junchen and Zhang Zhimou protested for harsh law, but she refused.
units.literal: Junchen, Zhang Zhimou, and others again submitted memorials requesting application of the great law; Wu Zetian did not permit it.

units.zh: 聖祖親釐象數，究極精微，前後制新儀七，測日月星辰，則窮極分秒；
units.en: The Kangxi emperor personally mastered calendrical astronomy, devised seven new instruments, and measured the sun, moon, and stars to the second.
units.literal: The Sacred Ancestor personally rectified numerology and celestial phenomena, penetrating the utmost subtlety; before and after he devised seven new instruments; in measuring sun, moon, and stars he exhausted fractions of seconds;

units.zh: 今以康熙年間實測各省及諸蒙古高度、偏度，並乾隆時憲所增省分，與回疆部落、兩金川土司等，晝夜永短，節氣早晚，推得高度、偏度備列焉。
units.en: Here Kangxi surveys, Qianlong additions, Xinjiang, and Jinchuan observations yield revised polar altitudes and longitudinal offsets.
units.literal: Now from Kangxi-era actual surveys of each province and Mongol banners, plus provinces added in the Qianlong Time Constitution, together with Muslim borderland tribes and the two Jinchuan chieftaincies — day and night length, solar-term timing — heights and offsets are derived and fully listed.

units.zh: 右康熙年間實測。
units.en: Above: Kangxi-era surveys.
units.literal: Above: Kangxi-era actual surveys.

units.zh: 有清統一區夏，聖聖相承。
units.en: The Qing unified China, one sage emperor following another.
units.literal: The Qing unified All-under-Heaven, sage succeeding sage.

units.zh: 度輿圖經緯，則穹歷幅隕。
units.en: In surveying terrestrial longitude and latitude, he covered every corner of the realm.
units.literal: in surveying the maps' longitude and latitude, he traversed every corner of the realm.

units.zh: 光緒六年，兩廣總督張之洞募沙民千人助守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，所募鄉兵，以防勇規制編之。
units.en: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand-dwellers for Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all organized as local militia under defensive brave regulations.
units.literal: Sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Guangs recruited one thousand sand-dwellers to help garrison Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves—all recruited local militia organized under defensive brave regulations.

units.zh: 敕封籓服禮清自太宗征服朝鮮，鑱石三田渡。
units.en: Investiture Protocol for Tributary Domains: From the Qing Taizong's conquest of Korea, a commemorative stone was carved at Sandian Ferry.
units.literal: Investiture Protocol for Tributary Domains: From the Qing Taizong's conquest of Korea, a stone was inscribed at Sandian Ferry.

units.zh: 昔蕭何之鎮關中，荀彧之居許下，不亦異於是乎！
units.en: Long ago Xiao He guarded Guanzhong and Xun Yu held Xudu — were they not utterly unlike this?
units.literal: In old days when Xiao He guarded Guanzhong and Xun Yu dwelt at Xudu — were they not utterly unlike this?

units.zh: 贊曰：閎、散胥附，蕭、曹扶翼。
units.en: The encomium says: Hongyao and San Yisheng gathered round in support; Xiao He and Cao Shen lent their aid.
units.literal: The encomium says: Hongyao and San Yisheng gathered round in support; Xiao He and Cao Shen lent their aid.

units.zh: 二十八年，言於直督袁世凱：「電報宜歸官有。
units.en: In 1902, he told Yuan Shikai, Governor-General of Zhili: "Telegraphy should be placed under government ownership.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he said to Yuan Shikai, Governor-General of Zhili: "Telegraphy should be placed under government ownership.

units.zh: 世凱謀諸執政者，以為然，聞於上。
units.en: Yuan Shikai consulted the ruling officials, who agreed, and reported to the throne.
units.literal: Yuan Shikai consulted the ruling officials, who agreed, and reported to the throne.

units.zh: 尋命世凱督辦電局，候補侍郎吳和喜副之。
units.en: Yuan Shikai was soon appointed to supervise the telegraph bureau, with Expectant Vice Minister Wu Hexi as his deputy.
units.literal: Soon Yuan Shikai was ordered to supervise the telegraph bureau, with Expectant Vice Minister Wu Hexi as his deputy.

units.zh: 七年，庶子陳寶琛以星變陳言，專劾寶鋆，請仿漢災異策免三公故事，立予罷斥。
units.en: In 1881 Sub-Reader Chen Baochen, citing a celestial omen, impeached Bao Yun alone and asked that he be dismissed at once, following the Han precedent of removing the three highest ministers after calamitous signs.
units.literal: In the seventh year Sub-Reader Chen Baochen, on a stellar omen, memorialized and specially impeached Bao Yun, asking to imitate the Han precedent of dismissing the three dukes on calamitous omens and immediately dismiss him.

units.zh: 陳寶琛謂其畏難巧卸，瞻徇情面，亦不能確有所指。
units.en: Chen Baochen accuses him of shirking hard tasks and showing favoritism, yet cannot point to anything specific.
units.literal: Chen Baochen says he shrinks from difficulty and cleverly shifts burdens, looks to favor and personal ties, yet cannot point to anything definite.

units.zh: 世宗復以歲久積差，準監臣改用橢圓術。
units.en: Yongzheng, seeing accumulated error over the years, had supervising astronomers adopt elliptical theory.
units.literal: The Shizong Emperor again, because long years had accumulated discrepancy, ordered supervising officials to adopt the elliptical method.

units.zh: 是時，李悝為魏文侯作盡地力之教，以為地方百里，提封九萬頃，除山澤邑居參分去一，為田六百萬畝，治田勤謹則畝益三升，不勤則損亦如之。
units.en: Serving Marquis Wen of Wei, Li Kui devised a program that quantified agricultural gains from more intensive cultivation within a calibrated assessment of available land.
units.literal: Then Li Kui for Marquis Wen of Wei made teachings of exhausting land power: in a hundred-li square domain with ninety-thousand qing under seal, subtracting mountains, marshes, and settlements by one-third leaves six million mu; diligent cultivation adds three sheng per mu, negligence loses the same.

units.zh: 今一夫挾五口，治田百畝，歲收畝一石半，為粟百五十石，除十一之稅十五石，餘百三十五石。
units.en: Li Kui's household arithmetic starts from a five-person household farming one hundred mu under average yield and tithe assumptions.
units.literal: Now one man supports five mouths, cultivating one hundred mu, yearly harvesting one and a half shi per mu, making one hundred fifty shi; removing one-tenth tax fifteen shi, remaining one hundred thirty-five.

units.zh: 又曰糴其貴傷民，甚賤傷農；
units.en: He argued that both price spikes and price collapses are socially destructive.
units.literal: He also said: if grain purchases are too expensive, people are harmed; if very cheap, farmers are harmed;

units.zh: 是故善平糴者，必謹觀歲有上中下孰。
units.en: Effective price-stabilization policy requires accurate harvest classification.
units.literal: Therefore those good at leveling grain must carefully observe whether the year is high, medium, or low harvest.

units.zh: 故大孰則上糴三而舍一，中孰則糴二，下孰則糴一，使民適足，賈平則止。
units.en: In good years the state should purchase and store grain proportionately, then stop once market prices are stabilized.
units.literal: Thus in a great harvest buy at ratio three and store one, in medium harvest buy two, in low harvest buy one; let people be just sufficient, and stop when prices are level.

units.zh: 行之魏國，國以富彊。
units.en: Implemented in Wei, this policy produced prosperity and military strength.
units.literal: Applied in Wei state, the state became rich and strong.

units.zh: 浙江巡撫硃軾闢佐幕，器其才。
units.en: Zhejiang Governor Zhu Shi recruited him to his staff and valued his talent.
units.literal: Zhejiang Governor Zhu Shi opened a staff and valued his talent.

units.zh: 雍正元年，重開明史館，軾薦之，引見稱旨，命入館纂修。
units.en: In the first year of Yongzheng, when the Ming History Office reopened, Zhu Shi recommended him. He pleased the emperor at audience and was ordered to join the compilation staff.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the Ming History Office was reopened; Shi recommended him; on audience he pleased the emperor and was ordered to enter the office to compile and edit.

units.zh: 清太祖、太宗之治遼東，刑制尚簡，重則斬，輕則鞭撲而已。
units.en: During the early Qing rule of the eastern Liao under the Taizu and Taizong emperors, penal law remained simple: serious offenses meant decapitation, minor ones no more than whipping and beating.
units.literal: Under the Taizu and Taizong emperors of the Qing, when they ruled the eastern Liao region, the penal system was still simple: serious cases were punished by decapitation, light ones by whipping and beating only.

units.zh: 高宗又以舊記星紀，間有疏漏，御製璣衡撫辰儀，重加測候。
units.en: Qianlong, finding gaps in older star catalogs, built the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and remeasured the sky.
units.literal: The Gaozong Emperor again, because old star records had occasional gaps, personally made the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and took new observations.

units.zh: 乾隆六十年以後，國史無徵，則從闕焉。
units.en: After Qianlong 60 the Veritable Records offer no material, so the account stops there.
units.literal: After Qianlong year 60 the National History has no testimony, and those years are therefore omitted.

units.zh: 迨平定回疆及兩金川，復令重度裏差，增入時憲。
units.en: After pacifying Xinjiang and the two Jinchuan campaigns, he ordered li-cha remeasured and entered into the Shixian calendar.
units.literal: When the Muslim borderlands and the Two Jinchuan were pacified, he again ordered remeasurement of li-cha and added the results to the Time Constitution calendar.

units.zh: 是年，劉坤一、張之洞等，以二十年來，各省練習洋操，屢經整頓，而舊日將領，於新操多未諳習。
units.en: That year Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong noted that after twenty years of foreign drill reforms, many old officers still did not know the new methods.
units.literal: That year Liu Kunyi, Zhang Zhidong, and others stated that over twenty years provinces had practiced foreign drill and been reorganized repeatedly, yet old commanders were mostly unversed in the new drill.

units.zh: 二十七年，以各省制兵防勇，積弊甚深，飭將軍、督、撫，就原有各營，嚴行裁汰，精選若干營，分為常備、續備、巡警等軍，更定餉章，一律操習新式槍砲。
units.en: In year 27 deep abuses in regular and brave troops led orders to cut rolls, pick elite camps for standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay, and train all on modern arms.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because regular troops and defense braves in each province had abuses too deep, generals, governors-general, and governors were ordered, starting from existing camps, to cut strictly, select certain camps, divide them into standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay regulations, and uniformly drill new-style firearms and cannon.

units.zh: 東西各國教將練兵要旨，約有十二：一曰教士以禮，使知有恥自重，一曰調護士卒起處飲食，一曰講明槍砲彈藥質性源流之法，一曰槍砲線路取准之法，一曰掘濠築壘避槍砲之法，一曰馬步砲各隊擇地借勢之法，一曰測量繪圖之法，一曰隊伍分合轉變之法，一曰守衛偵探之法，一曰行軍工程製造之法，一曰籌備行軍衣糧輜重之法，一曰行軍醫藥之法。
units.en: East and West taught twelve essentials for officers: instill discipline and self-respect; care for men's food and quarters; teach ballistics and powder; teach aiming and lines of fire; teach entrenching against fire; teach terrain use for horse, foot, and guns; teach surveying and mapping; teach unit maneuvers; teach guard and reconnaissance; teach field engineering; teach logistics; and teach field medicine.
units.literal: Eastern and Western countries' essentials for teaching officers and drilling troops numbered about twelve: first, teach soldiers ritual so they know shame and self-respect; second, care for soldiers' lodging and food; third, explain methods for the nature and origin of firearms, ammunition, and powder; fourth, methods for gun lines of fire and aiming; fifth, methods for digging moats and building works to avoid gunfire; sixth, methods for cavalry, infantry, and artillery each to choose ground and use terrain; seventh, methods of surveying and mapping; eighth, methods of dividing, combining, and transforming units; ninth, methods of guard and reconnaissance; tenth, methods of march engineering and manufacture; eleventh, methods of preparing march clothing, grain, and transport; twelfth, methods of march medicine.

units.zh: 更請仿英、法之總營務處，日本之參謀部，於都城專設衙門，掌全國水陸兵制、餉章、地理繪圖、操練法式、儲備糧餉、轉運舟車、外交偵探等事。
units.en: They also asked for a capital office modeled on British and French war ministries and Japan's general staff to run national land and sea forces, pay, maps, drill, logistics, transport, and intelligence.
units.literal: They further requested imitating Britain and France's general military affairs offices and Japan's general staff, establishing a dedicated yamen in the capital to manage nationwide land and naval organization, pay regulations, geography and mapping, drill methods, grain and pay reserves, transport of boats and carts, foreign affairs and intelligence, and other matters.

units.zh: 令內外臣工合議。
units.en: Court and provincial officials were told to deliberate together.
units.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside were ordered to discuss jointly.

units.zh: 順治元年，刑部左侍郎黨崇雅奏言：「舊制凡刑獄重犯，自大逆、大盜決不待時外，餘俱監候處決。
units.en: In Shunzhi 1, Dang Chongya, left vice minister of the Ministry of Justice, memorialized: "Under the former system, all serious prisoners except those guilty of great sedition or great robbery—who were executed at once—were held in custody awaiting sentence.
units.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, the Ministry of Justice's left vice minister Dang Chongya memorialized: "Under the old system, for all heavy criminals in prisons, except great sedition and great robbery, which were executed without delay, the rest were all held awaiting execution.

units.zh: 此有清言秋、朝審之始。
units.en: This passage marks the Qing dynasty's own account of how autumn and court review began.
units.literal: This is where Qing statements on the beginning of autumn and court review start.

units.zh: 在京有熱審、朝審之例，每至霜降後方請旨處決。
units.en: In the capital the summer review and court review applied, and execution required imperial approval only after the Frost's Descent.
units.literal: In the capital there were the precedents of summer review and court review; only after Frost's Descent each year was imperial instruction sought for execution.

units.zh: 在外直省，亦有三司秋審之例，未嘗一麗死刑輒棄於市。
units.en: In the provinces as well, the three offices conducted autumn review, and a death sentence was never carried out the moment it was pronounced.
units.literal: In the outer provinces directly administered, there was also the precedent of the three offices' autumn review; never was a death sentence immediately cast upon the market.

units.zh: 望照例區別，以昭欽恤。」
units.en: I beg that the old distinctions be preserved, to manifest the throne's compassionate regard for human life."
units.literal: It is hoped that distinction will be made according to precedent, to display imperial compassion.

units.zh: 御史陸祖修亦劾佛倫袒輔，且言：「九卿會議時，尚書科爾坤等阿佛倫意，尚書張玉書、左都御史徐乾學言興屯所佔民田應還之民，科爾坤置不聞。
units.en: Censor Lu Zuxiu also impeached Folun for favoring Fu, stating: "At the Nine Ministers' conference, Minister Ke'erkun and others toadied to Folun's intent; Ministers Zhang Yushu and Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue said the civilian fields seized for military colonies should be returned to the people, but Ke'erkun paid no heed.
units.literal: Censor Lu Zuxiu also impeached Folun for favoring Fu, and stated: 'At the conference of the Nine Ministers, Minister Ke'erkun and others toadied to Folun's intent; Ministers Zhang Yushu and Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue said the civilian fields seized for military colonies should be returned to the people, but Ke'erkun paid no heed.

units.zh: 十一年，穆宗即位，載垣等獲罪。
units.en: In the eleventh year (1861) the Tongzhi Emperor ascended the throne, and Zaiyuan and his associates were condemned.
units.literal: In the eleventh year the Muzong Emperor ascended the throne; Zaiyuan and others were punished for crimes.

units.zh: 詔曰：「黃宗漢本年春赴熱河，危詞力阻回鑾。
units.en: An edict declared: "Huang Zonghan went to Rehe this spring and used alarmist language to block the emperor's return to Beijing.
units.literal: An edict said: "Huang Zonghan this spring went to Rehe and with alarming words strongly obstructed the return of the imperial procession.

units.zh: 迨皇考梓宮將回京，又以京城可慮，遍告於人，希冀阻止。
units.en: When Our late father's coffin was about to return to the capital, he spread word that the city was unsafe, telling everyone he could in hopes of stopping the move.
units.literal: When Our late father's coffin was about to return to the capital, he again said the capital was to be feared, telling everyone widely, hoping to obstruct it.

units.zh: 其意存迎合載垣等，眾所共知。
units.en: His aim was plainly to curry favor with Zaiyuan and his party, as everyone knew.
units.literal: His intention was to curry favor with Zaiyuan and others, as all know.

units.zh: 聲名品行如此，若任其濫廁卿貳，何以表率屬僚？
units.en: With a reputation and conduct such as this, how can he be allowed to hold high office and set an example for other officials?
units.literal: With reputation and conduct such as this, if he is allowed to fill high offices at random, how can he set an example for subordinates?

units.zh: 革職永不敘用，以為大僚輭媚者戒。」
units.en: Strip him of office and never employ him again, as a warning to high officials who cringe before power."
units.literal: Strip office and never employ again, to warn high officials who are soft and fawning."

units.zh: 孫之旭，字孟升。
units.en: His grandson Zhixu, whose style was Mengsheng,
units.literal: His grandson Zhixu, style name Mengsheng.

units.zh: 康熙四十五年進士，官編修，改御史。
units.en: passed the jinshi examination in 1706, served as a Hanlin compiler, and became a censor.
units.literal: became a jinshi in the forty-fifth year of Kangxi, served as compiler, and was transferred to censor.

units.zh: 出為霸昌道，內遷左通政。
units.en: He was posted to the Bachang Circuit and later promoted to left vice commissioner of communications in the capital.
units.literal: He went out as Bachang Circuit commissioner and was promoted within the capital to left vice commissioner of communications.

units.zh: 所至皆有聲。
units.en: Wherever he served he won a reputation.
units.literal: Wherever he went he gained renown.

units.zh: 吳橋知縣勞乃宣禁傳習，為書上裕祿，格不行。
units.en: Wuqiao Magistrate Lao Naixuan forbade Boxer practice and wrote to Yu Lu, but the letter was blocked.
units.literal: Lao Naixuan, magistrate of Wuqiao, forbade transmission and practice and wrote a letter to Yu Lu, but it was blocked and not carried out.

units.zh: 會變法議起，袁世凱奏設修訂法律館，命家本偕伍廷芳總其事；
units.en: When reform was debated, Yuan Shikai memorialized to establish the Commission for the Revision of Laws and ordered Jiaben and Wu Tingfang to direct it jointly.
units.literal: When discussion of reform arose, Yuan Shikai memorialized establishing the Commission for the Revision of Laws, ordering Jiaben together with Wu Tingfang to take general charge of the matter.

units.zh: 十六年春，世祖幸南苑，雍建疏言：「昨因聖體違和，傳諭孟春饗太廟，遣官致祭。
units.en: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shunzhi Emperor went to the Southern Park, and Yongjian submitted a memorial: 'Recently, because Your Majesty was unwell, the court announced that the spring sacrifice at the Grand Temple would be performed by dispatched officials.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shizu Emperor visited the Southern Park; Yongjian memorialized, saying: 'Yesterday, because the Sacred Person was unwell, an edict was issued that at the first month of spring the Grand Temple would be feasted and officials dispatched to perform the sacrifice.

units.zh: 各國親王覲見儀，始光緒二十四年。
units.en: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.
units.literal: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.

units.zh: 德國親王亨利入覲，帝幸頤和園，御仁壽殿，亨利公服入，遞國書，帝慰勞之。
units.en: The German Prince Henry was received in audience; the emperor went to the Summer Palace and held court in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity; Prince Henry entered in formal dress, presented his credentials, and the emperor comforted him.
units.literal: The German Prince Henry was received in audience; the emperor went to the Summer Palace and held court in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity; Prince Henry entered in formal dress, presented his credentials, and the emperor comforted him.

units.zh: 既，亨利慾覲皇太后，帝奉懿旨代見。
units.en: Afterward Prince Henry wished to pay respects to the empress dowager; the emperor received him on her behalf by her express command.
units.literal: Afterward Prince Henry wished to pay respects to the empress dowager; the emperor received him on her behalf by her express command.

units.zh: 然後奉國書進，慶親王降左階接受，陳玉案，亨利等又一鞠躬，帝頷首答之，操國語慰勞。
units.en: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.
units.literal: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.

units.zh: 德繙譯官譯畢，亨利等又一鞠躬，帝仍頷首答之。
units.en: When the German interpreter had finished translating, Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor again nodded in reply.
units.literal: When the German interpreter had finished translating, Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor again nodded in reply.

units.zh: 齎奏國書，必自中門入，帝必躬親接受。
units.en: When bearing memorials and credentials, they must enter through the central gate, and the emperor must personally receive them.
units.literal: When bearing memorials and credentials, they must enter through the central gate, and the emperor must personally receive them.

units.zh: 設宴乾清宮，帝必躬親入座。
units.en: Banquets were to be held in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, and the emperor must personally take his seat.
units.literal: Banquets were to be held in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, and the emperor must personally take his seat.

units.zh: 二十七年，聯軍平拳匪，各國挾求更改禮節。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.

units.zh: 是日巳刻，御玉瀾堂，亨利偕德使海靖等入，外部司官引殿東便門外入布幄少憩。
units.en: That day at the si hour, the emperor held court at the Hall of Jade Ripples; Prince Henry entered together with the German envoy Heyking and others; officials of the foreign ministry led them in through the east side gate of the hall to rest briefly in the canvas tent.
units.literal: That day at the si hour, the emperor held court at the Hall of Jade Ripples; Prince Henry entered together with the German envoy Heyking and others; officials of the foreign ministry led them in through the east side gate of the hall to rest briefly in the canvas tent.

units.zh: 駕至，扈從如儀，鳴鞭三，升座。
units.en: When the imperial procession arrived, the escort formed as prescribed; the whip was cracked three times, and the emperor ascended the throne.
units.literal: When the imperial procession arrived, the escort formed as prescribed; the whip was cracked three times, and the emperor ascended the throne.

units.zh: 慶親王等侍左右，外部長官率亨利等自中門入，北鄉一鞠躬，行數武又一鞠躬，至龍柱前又一鞠躬。
units.en: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.
units.literal: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.

units.zh: 睿親王既薨，諸阿附者乃互相傾，何洛會之獄，譚泰證之；
units.en: After Prince Rui's death his followers turned on one another; Tan Tai testified in He Luohui's case;
units.literal: After Prince Rui died, those who had clung to him turned on one another; in He Luohui's case Tan Tai bore witness;
